goal: Integrate the 5 Reborn mods (crys_the_swarm_reborn + 4 sub-mods) into the CMRE runtime as an optional mod package, loadable via -EnableReborn switch on launch-cmre-alenger.ps1.
acceptance: The 5 Reborn mods are copied to cmre-runtime/Mods/reborn/ with sub-mod paths rewritten to Mods/reborn/...
SwarmStory.SC2Campaign and swarmstoryutil.sc2mod are deployed to the SC2 install Campaigns/ directory.
cmre-alenger-dependencies.json declares the optionalPackageMods block listing the 5 Reborn mods.
launch-cmre-alenger.ps1 supports -EnableReborn switch that syncs and loads the Reborn mods.
A CMRE map launched with -EnableReborn reaches the ready state with no new ScriptError.
